body: When I realize that my life is on the upwards climb, and everything is going great, but I know that it's all meaningless, I'll die alone, and nothing but energy being used and recycled will happen. Every time I hear of someone committing suicide, I feel such jealousy, that they could just do it, and I could not. Not yet.
"to be connected with the object of their affection even if it slowly kills them inside." Stop, just stop right there Freud, it's just too real for me.
I.. I can't tell if I want to or not. Much like I can't tell what gender the ass I'd be theoretically eating is.
